summary: Frontend-only smoke + integration test of Vertex Web Solutions single-page landing. All 13 sections render with no React/console errors, all required data-testids present, all 13 phone CTAs use href='tel:3054693585', 18 industry cards present, demo options switch the recommendation panel correctly, all 7 anchor nav links smoothly scroll to the right section (desktop + mobile), mobile menu toggle works at 390px, footer contains copyright '© 2026 VERTEX WEB SOLUTIONS', Privacy/Terms links, and 12 testimonial marquee cards with placeholder disclaimer. Only finding: page text still contains the literal words 'PRICES' and 'plan' (used contextually) which violates the strict forbidden-word scan from the spec.

content_issues.issue: Rendered page contains the forbidden word 'PRICES'. Strings 'NO PRICES ONLINE · CALL TO DISCUSS YOUR SETUP' (demo panel) and 'NO PRICES LISTED ONLINE - CALL TO DISCUSS THE BEST SETUP FOR YOUR BUSINESS' (final CTA) trip the spec scan that forbids the substring 'price'.
Text 'Call 305-469-3585 to plan your strategy' contains the forbidden word 'plan'. Used as a verb but violates strict spec scan.

action_items: Replace 'NO PRICES ONLINE · CALL TO DISCUSS YOUR SETUP' microcopy in InteractiveDemo.jsx with a non-price wording (e.g. 'CALL TO DISCUSS YOUR CUSTOM SETUP').
Replace 'NO PRICES LISTED ONLINE - CALL TO DISCUSS THE BEST SETUP FOR YOUR BUSINESS' microcopy in FinalCTA.jsx similarly.
Reword 'Call 305-469-3585 to plan your strategy' in SocialMediaDeepDive.jsx to avoid the word 'plan' (e.g. 'to map out your strategy').
critical_code_review_comments: App.js wraps a single landing page in BrowserRouter and catches '*' route - harmless but unnecessary for an SPA with no real routes.
Several components use data-testids consistently - good. Phone number hardcoded across many files; consider a single constant for maintainability.
No backend used; no .env keys touched - compliant with constraints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All structural/functional tests pass. Only remaining items are 3 microcopy strings that contain forbidden words 'prices' and 'plan'. Once fixed, re-run a quick playwright text scan for substrings ['$','starting at','price','pricing','plan'] on document.body.innerText - all should return zero hits. Public URL: https://lead-capture-hub-54.preview.emergentagent.com.
rca of the issue: Spec forbids the substrings 'price','pricing','plan' anywhere on the page. Developers added microcopy meta-statements like 'NO PRICES ONLINE' to reassure visitors, but the literal substring 'price' is still rendered. Similarly 'plan your strategy' uses 'plan' as a verb. Mitigation: rewrite the three offending strings.
